messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition marking dative “to” | **നിനക്കു** | “to you” | OK | | **te** | 2nd‑person singular pronoun (acc.) | **നിനക്കു** | “to you” | OK | | **convien** | impersonal modal “it behoves / it is obligatory” | **വെയ്ക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്** | “must keep/hold” | OK | | **tenere** | infinitive “to hold / to keep” | **വെയ്ക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്** | “must keep/hold” | OK | | **altro** | adjective “another” | **മറ്റൊരു** | “another” | OK | | **vïaggio** | noun “journey / course” | **യാത്ര** | “journey” | OK | | **rispuose** | verb “he replied” | **മറുപടി നൽകി** | “gave a reply” | OK | | **poi** | temporal adverb “after / when” | **കണ്ടപ്പോൾ** | “when (he) saw” | OK | | **che** | subordinating conjunction “when” | **കണ്ടപ്പോൾ** | “when (he) saw” | OK | | **lagrimar** | infinitive “to weep” | **കരയുന്നത്** | “weeping” | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person pronoun “me” | **എന്നെ** | “me” | OK | | **vide** | verb “he saw” | **കണ്ടപ്പോൾ** | “when (he) saw” | OK | | **se** | conditional “if” | **ആഗ്രഹിച്ചാൽ** | “if (you) wish” | OK | | **vuo'** | verb “wish / want” | **ആഗ്രഹിച്ചാൽ** | “if (you) wish” | OK | | **campar** | infinitive “to escape” | **രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ** | “to escape” | OK | | **d'** | preposition “from” | ** നിന്ന്** | “from” | OK | | **esto** | demonstrative “this” | **ഈ** | “this” | OK | | **loco** | noun “place” | **സ്ഥലത്തിൽ** | “place (in)” | OK | | **selvaggio** | adjective “savage / wild” | **കാട്ടുപോലുള്ള** | “like a forest / savage” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **None** – every source token finds an appropriate Malayalam counterpart; no missing, wrong, grammatical, or unnecessary elements were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: നിനക്കു മറ്റൊരു യാത്ര കൈവശം വെയ്ക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: അവൻ മറുപടി നൽകി അവൻ എന്നെ കരയുന്നത് കണ്ടപ്പോൾ, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: നീ ഈ കാട്ടുപോലുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചാൽ; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` നിനക്കു മറ്റൊരു യാത്ര കൈവശം വെയ്ക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്, അവൻ മറുപടി നൽകി അവൻ എന്നെ കരയുന്നത് കണ്ടപ്പോൾ, നീ ഈ കാട്ടുപോലുള്ള സ്ഥലത്തിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ ആഗ്രഹിച്ചാൽ; ```
